title: The estimate part lookup shows Not Tracked for an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with 3 in one bin location, bin location A.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup rows can be compared.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, that is still an estimate, with a line, line 1, that holds no parts.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click Add Part under line 1.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Part Number field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part lookup opens for line 1 of work order 1.

Step 2:

  • Part B's row shows "Inventory Qty: 4".
  • Part A's row shows "Not Tracked" in place of "Inventory Qty", and its bin chip for bin location A with 3 still shows, as a shelf reference.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R21: “In the part lookup on work orders, estimates, part sales and purchase orders, an untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in place of "Inventory Qty: {n}". Its bin chips stay as a shelf reference.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “An untracked part is not counted. The Inventory list shows "Not Tracked" instead of its total quantity, and its Min and Max are kept but not used. Its bins and their quantities stay on screen as a shelf reference. It can still be used on work orders and invoices.”
